description: UART receiver, 8N1, oversampling FSM (start/data/stop), framing-error flag, valid/ack handshake.

clock_reset.clk: single clock (27 MHz on Tang Primer 20K)
clock_reset.clk_en: step enable; every state register gated; tie 1 for full rate

status_protocol: rx_valid is held until rx_ack; sampling continues independently. Byte becomes valid after the third stop-bit sample. Consume before the next frame completes; on overrun the unread older byte is retained and the new byte is discarded. framing_err accompanies held rx_data.

validation.golden_source: tools/golden_model.py (independent Python model, no RTL output)
validation.sim: iverilog PASS (masks 001F, 000F, 0001, 000E, 0000); byte stream identical to sim/golden_urx.txt
